notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
description:
Cast Scouting Trek by paying {1}{G}, searching your library for all basic lands in your library and putting them on top.
Play any land.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave the basic land on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, causing you to reveal the basic land on top of your library and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 3.
